hyperedges.label: Per-Agent Query Expansion: All four agents (PubMed, FDA, Clinical Trials, Local) follow identical query expansion prompt structure targeting their respective databases
Bracketed Citation Grounding: All synthesis prompts enforce source-only answers with bracketed inline citations [1],[2] — a shared evidence-grounding design contract
